name: dsh-personal-memory
description: Cross-session GLOBAL personal memory for DeepSeek Harness (meow-memory fork): seven-layer SQLite memory stored in a single user-global database, first-turn snapshot injection, per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/project tools, automatic reflection with reflection-fold UI, idle-triggered dream consolidation, and a memory explorer panel (cards + knowledge graph) in the dsh web frontend.

scripts.test:core: node tests/retrieval.mjs && node tests/entities-llm.mjs && node tests/star-layout.mjs
